question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.2.
solution: The correct answer is '**illegal**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The title of the given passage can be** 'Dolphin boom in Odisha's Chilika lake'.** • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**illegal**'. • It means 'not allowed by the law'. (गै़र-क़ानूनी, अवैध) • *Example: It is **illegal** to own a gun without a special license.* • Thus, the correct answer is** Option 2.** **Correct Passage:__** *The rise in the Irrawaddy dolphin population in Chilika can be attributed to the eviction of **illegal** fish enclosures. After thousands of hectares of Chilika lake were made (3) ______ free, Irrawaddy dolphins found unobstructed area for movement. (4) ______, due to the COVID-19 lockdown last year, there were comparatively fewer tourist boats on Chilika lake, which made it (5) ______ for dolphins to move from one part of the lake to another. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **unconstitutional**: not in accordance with the political constitution or with procedural rules. (राजनीतिक संविधान या प्रक्रियात्मक नियमों के अनुसार नहीं) • **unwarranted**: not justified or authorized. (उचित या अधिकृत नहीं) • **illegitimate**: (used about a child) born to parents who are not married to each other. [(शिशु) अविवाहित स्‍त्री-पुरुष से जन्‍मा, अवैध; जारज] 45:Td68, The correct answer is '**encroachment**'.
